packaging.note: Not new infrastructure. Packaging of enterprise_infrastructure, monitoring_dashboard, quality scoring, and drift detection.

caveat.body: SKUs 02 and 03 are sellable today because the components exist. OBS-01 still needs the dashboard polished into a customer-facing view before it sits in front of a paying client. The wedge play this week is AUD-01.

pricing_logic.note: OBS-01 is the impulse-buy entry. AUD-01 is the one-time wedge that converts. OBS-02/03 are the margin. AUD-02 and OBS-ENT are where real revenue lives.

compounding.note: Every OBS customer generates behavioral data that makes the underwriting engine (product line 01) smarter. These two product lines compound each other.

bundle_rules: OBS-ENT subsumes OBS-01, OBS-02, OBS-03, and AUD-02. Do not double-charge.
AUD-01 remains a one-time engagement even on ENT accounts.
